```html
<script>
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const S={bank:'',account:'',amount:'',pw:'',verified:false,pending:'',tab:'bank',busy:false,error:'',limit:''};
let current='home',decision='',returnFocus=null,built=false;
window.__log=[];
window.__screen=()=>current;
window.__dump=()=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__log));

function show(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('on',s.dataset.screen===name));
  current=name;
  window.__log.push({type:'screen_enter',to:name});
  document.querySelector('.screen.on').scrollTop=0;
}
function reset(){
  Object.assign(S,{bank:'',account:'',amount:'',pw:'',verified:false,pending:'',tab:'bank',busy:false,error:'',limit:''});
  $('acc-input').value='';
  $('bank-search').value='';
  $('decision').hidden=true;
  $('processing').hidden=true;
  renderAccount();renderAmount();renderPw();
}
window.__startTask=()=>{window.__log.length=0;build();reset();show('home');};
function fmt(v){return BigInt(v||'0').toLocaleString('ko-KR');}
function money(){return BigInt(S.amount||'0');}
function korean(v){
  if(!v)return '';
  const digits=['','일','이','삼','사','오','육','칠','팔','구'];
  const small=['','십','백','천'],large=['','만','억','조','경','해'];
  let n=BigInt(v),parts=[],group=0;
  while(n>0n){
    let x=Number(n%10000n),t='';
    for(let i=3;i>=0;i--){
      const d=Math.floor(x/10**i)%10;
      if(d)t+=(d===1&&i>0?'':digits[d])+small[i];
    }
    if(t)parts.unshift(t+(large[group]||''));
    n/=10000n;group++;
  }
  return (parts.join(' ')||'영')+' 원';
}
function changed(){
  S.verified=false;S.error='';S.limit='';
  renderAccount();
}
function renderAccount(){
  $('picked-bank').textContent=S.bank||'은행 또는 증권사 선택';
  $('acc-error').hidden=S.error!=='account';
  $('bank-error').hidden=S.error!=='bank';
  $('acc-status').textContent=S.limit;
  const missing=[];
  if(!S.account)missing.push('계좌번호를 입력해 주세요.');
  if(!S.bank)missing.push('은행 또는 증권사를 선택해 주세요.');
  $('account-guide').textContent=missing.join(' ')||(S.verified?'받는 계좌 확인을 마쳤습니다.':'은행과 계좌번호를 다시 확인해 주세요.');
  $('acc-next').disabled=!!missing.length;
}
function validate(){
  S.verified=false;
  if(!S.account||!S.bank){renderAccount();return false;}
  if(S.account!=='110234567890'){
    S.error='account';
    $('acc-error-text').textContent='받는 계좌번호가 맞지 않습니다. 현재 입력: '+S.account+'. 받는 분에게 받은 번호와 비교해 고쳐 주세요.';
  }else if(S.bank!=='신한'){
    S.error='bank';
    $('bank-error-text').textContent='선택한 은행이 받는 계좌의 은행과 다릅니다. 현재 선택: '+S.bank+'. 받는 분에게 은행 이름을 확인하고 다시 선택해 주세요.';
  }else{S.error='';S.verified=true;}
  renderAccount();
  if(S.error){
    if(current!=='account')show('account');
    $(S.error==='account'?'acc-error':'bank-error').focus();
    window.__log.push({type:'error',id:S.error==='account'?'wrong-account':'wrong-bank'});
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function accountEdit(value,caret){
  $('acc-input').value=value;S.account=value;
  changed();
  $('acc-input').setSelectionRange(caret,caret);
}
function accountKey(v){
  const f=$('acc-input'),start=f.selectionStart??S.account.length,end=f.selectionEnd??start;
  const next=S.account.slice(0,start)+v+S.account.slice(end);
  if(next.length>14){
    S.limit='계좌번호는 최대 14자리입니다. 더 입력하려면 잘못된 숫자를 먼저 지워 주세요.';
    renderAccount();return;
  }
  accountEdit(next,start+v.length);
}
function renderAmount(){
  const n=money();
  $('amt-recipient').textContent=S.bank+' '+S.account;
  $('amt-display').textContent=n?fmt(n)+'원':'금액을 입력해 주세요';
  $('amt-korean').textContent=n?korean(n):'';
  const over=n>1000000n;
  $('amt-guide').textContent=over?'잔액보다 '+fmt(n-1000000n)+'원 많습니다. 보낼 수 있는 잔액은 1,000,000원입니다. 금액을 줄여 주세요.':n?'금액을 확인한 뒤 이체 내역 확인을 눌러 주세요.':'보낼 금액을 입력해 주세요.';
  $('amt-guide').classList.toggle('error',over);
  $('amt-next').disabled=!n||over;
}
function renderSummary(){
  $('cf-bank').textContent=S.bank;
  $('cf-acc').textContent=S.account;
  $('cf-amt').textContent=fmt(money())+'원 · '+korean(money());
  $('dn-bank').textContent=S.bank;
  $('dn-acc').textContent=S.account;
  $('dn-amt').textContent=fmt(money());
}
function renderPw(){
  $('pw-dots').textContent='●'.repeat(S.pw.length)+'○'.repeat(4-S.pw.length);
  $('pw-status').textContent='4자리 중 '+S.pw.length+'자리 입력';
  $('pw-submit').disabled=S.pw.length!==4||S.busy;
  document.querySelectorAll('#pwpad button,[data-action="pw-del"]').forEach(b=>b.disabled=S.busy);
}
function renderBanks(){
  let visible=0;
  const q=$('bank-search').value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  for(const kind of ['bank','sec']){
    $('grid-'+kind).hidden=S.tab!==kind;
    document.querySelectorAll('#grid-'+kind+' button').forEach(b=>{
      b.hidden=!b.dataset.bank.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q);
      b.classList.toggle('selected',b.dataset.bank===S.pending);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.bank===S.pending));
      if(kind===S.tab&&!b.hidden)visible++;
    });
  }
  $('tab-bank').classList.toggle('selected',S.tab==='bank');
  $('tab-sec').classList.toggle('selected',S.tab==='sec');
  $('tab-bank').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(S.tab==='bank'));
  $('tab-sec').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(S.tab==='sec'));
  $('bank-choice').textContent=S.pending||'아직 선택하지 않았습니다.';
  $('bank-apply').disabled=!S.pending;
  $('bank-none').hidden=visible>0;
}
function openBank(){
  build();
  S.pending=S.bank;
  if(S.bank){
    const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-action="pick-bank"]')).find(b=>b.dataset.bank===S.bank);
    if(b)S.tab=b.closest('#grid-sec')?'sec':'bank';
  }
  renderBanks();show('bank');
  const selected=document.querySelector('#grid-'+S.tab+' .selected');
  if(selected&&!selected.hidden)selected.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});
}
function ask(kind,el){
  decision=kind;returnFocus=el;
  $('decision-title').textContent=kind==='cancel'?'이체를 취소할까요?':'입력한 내용을 모두 지울까요?';
  $('decision-text').textContent=kind==='cancel'?'아직 돈을 보내지 않았습니다. 취소하면 입력한 은행, 계좌번호, 금액을 지우고 홈으로 돌아갑니다.':kind==='account'?'입력한 계좌번호를 모두 지웁니다. 은행과 금액은 그대로 남습니다.':'입력한 금액을 모두 지웁니다. 은행과 계좌번호는 그대로 남습니다.';
  $('decision-yes').textContent=kind==='cancel'?'이체 취소하기':'전체 지우기';
  $('decision').hidden=false;
  document.querySelector('.screen.on').inert=true;
  $('decision').querySelector('.dialog').focus();
}
function closeDecision(){
  $('decision').hidden=true;
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.inert=false);
  if(returnFocus)returnFocus.focus();
}
function build(){
  if(built||!window.PRESERVED)return;
  if(!window.PRESERVED.BANKS||!window.PRESERVED.SECS||
     !window.PRESERVED.AMT_KEYS||!window.PRESERVED.ACC_KEYS||
     !window.PRESERVED.PW_KEYS||!window.PRESERVED.QUICK)return;
  function keys(id,list,action){
    list.forEach(v=>{
      const b=document.createElement('button');
      b.dataset.action=action;
      b.dataset.v=String(v);
      b.textContent=String(v);
      $(id).appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  keys('acc-pad',window.PRESERVED.ACC_KEYS,'acc-num');
  keys('amt-pad',window.PRESERVED.AMT_KEYS,'num');
  keys('pwpad',window.PRESERVED.PW_KEYS,'pw');
  window.PRESERVED.QUICK.forEach(v=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.dataset.action='quick';
    b.dataset.v=String(v);
    b.textContent=String(v)==='all'?'잔액 전액 입력':fmt(v)+'원 추가';
    $('amt-quick').appendChild(b);
  });
  function institutions(id,list){
    list.forEach(n=>{
      const b=document.createElement('button');
      b.dataset.action='pick-bank';
      b.dataset.bank=String(n);
      b.textContent=String(n);
      $(id).appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  institutions('grid-bank',window.PRESERVED.BANKS);
  institutions('grid-sec',window.PRESERVED.SECS);
  built=true;renderBanks();renderPw();
}
$('acc-input').addEventListener('input',()=>{
  const f=$('acc-input'),raw=f.value,pos=f.selectionStart;
  const numeric=raw.replace(/\D/g,'');
  S.account=numeric.slice(0,14);f.value=S.account;changed();
  if(raw!==numeric||numeric.length>14){
    S.limit=numeric.length>14?'계좌번호는 최대 14자리입니다. 추가한 숫자는 입력하지 않았습니다.':'하이픈 없이 숫자만 입력해 주세요.';
    renderAccount();
  }
  f.setSelectionRange(Math.min(pos,S.account.length),Math.min(pos,S.account.length));
});
$('bank-search').addEventListener('input',renderBanks);
$('phone').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const el=e.target.closest('[data-action]');
  if(!el||el.disabled)return;
  const a = el.dataset.action;
  if(S.busy)return;
  window.__log.push({type:'action',action:a,screen:current});
  if(a==='go-recipient'){build();reset();show('recipient');}
  else if(a==='go-account'){renderAccount();show('account');}
  else if(a==='previous'){
    if(current==='bank'){S.pending=S.bank;renderAccount();show('account');}
    else{
      const prev={recipient:'home',account:'recipient',amount:'account',confirm:'amount',password:'confirm'};
      show(prev[current]||'home');
    }
  }
  else if(a==='cancel'){ask('cancel',el);}
  else if(a==='decision-no'){closeDecision();}
  else if(a==='decision-yes'){
    closeDecision();
    if(decision==='cancel'){reset();show('home');}
    else if(decision==='account'){accountEdit('',0);$('acc-input').focus();}
    else{S.amount='';renderAmount();}
  }
  else if(a==='acc-focus'){$('acc-input').focus();}
  else if(a==='acc-num'){accountKey(el.dataset.v);}
  else if(a==='acc-del'){
    const f=$('acc-input'),start=f.selectionStart??S.account.length,end=f.selectionEnd??start;
    const left=start===end?Math.max(0,start-1):start;
    accountEdit(S.account.slice(0,left)+S.account.slice(end),left);
  }
  else if(a==='acc-clear'){ask('account',el);}
  else if(a==='open-bank'){openBank();}
  else if(a==='search-focus'){$('bank-search').focus();}
  else if(a==='search-clear'){$('bank-search').value='';renderBanks();}
  else if(a==='tab-bank'){S.tab='bank';renderBanks();}
  else if(a==='tab-sec'){S.tab='sec';renderBanks();}
  else if(a==='pick-bank'){
    S.pending=el.dataset.bank;
    renderBanks();$('bank-choice').scrollIntoView({block:'center'});
  }
  else if(a==='bank-apply'){
    if(!S.pending)return;
    if(S.bank!==S.pending){S.bank=S.pending;changed();}
    renderAccount();show('account');
  }
  else if(a==='account-next'){if(validate()){renderAmount();show('amount');}}
  else if(a==='num'){S.amount=(S.amount+el.dataset.v).replace(/^0+/,'');renderAmount();}
  else if(a==='del'){S.amount=S.amount.slice(0,-1);renderAmount();}
  else if(a==='quick'){
    S.amount=String(el.dataset.v==='all'?1000000n:money()+BigInt(el.dataset.v));
    renderAmount();
  }
  else if(a==='amount-clear'){ask('amount',el);}
  else if(a==='amount-next'){
    if(money()<=0n||money()>1000000n)return;
    if(!S.verified&&!validate())return;
    renderSummary();show('confirm');
  }
  else if(a==='edit-account'){renderAccount();show('account');}
  else if(a==='edit-amount'){renderAmount();show('amount');}
  else if(a==='send'){if(validate()){S.pw='';renderPw();show('password');}}
  else if(a==='pw'){if(S.pw.length<4){S.pw+=el.dataset.v;renderPw();}}
  else if(a==='pw-del'){S.pw=S.pw.slice(0,-1);renderPw();}
  else if(a==='pw-submit'){
    if(S.pw.length!==4)return;
    S.busy=true;renderPw();$('processing').hidden=false;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      renderSummary();S.pw='';S.busy=false;$('processing').hidden=true;renderPw();
      window.__log.push({type:'mock_transfer_complete',amount:String(money())});
      show('done');
    },350);
  }
  else if(a==='finish'){window.__log.push({type:'task_end'});show('home');}
});
$('phone').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if($('decision').hidden)return;
  if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();closeDecision();}
  if(e.key==='Tab'){
    const buttons=Array.from($('decision').querySelectorAll('button'));
    const first=buttons[0],last=buttons[buttons.length-1];
    if(e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===first||document.activeElement.classList.contains('dialog'))){
      e.preventDefault();last.focus();
    }else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){
      e.preventDefault();first.focus();
    }
  }
});
build();
if(!built){
  const timer=setInterval(()=>{build();if(built)clearInterval(timer);},50);
}
renderAccount();renderAmount();renderPw();
window.__log.push({type:'screen_enter',to:'home'});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```
